title: Influence bound from positive pivotal count
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1)$, let $f$ be a monotone sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $w$ be a natural number. If at every input at most $w$ coordinates are pivotal while the output is $+1$, then the total influence of $f$ under the product distribution with bias parameter $p$ is at most $4pw$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
At every input, the number of coordinates pivotal with output $+1$ is at most $w$
